notes: Barcode scanner reworked into plate identification. On Configuration - Labware format there is now a scanner connection (serial port + Connect + Test read + status, like the device connections) plus a learn-once barcode-to-format map: scan a plate and the app selects its microplate format automatically and loads that format's recipe; teach a new plate with Assign last scan. USB keyboard-mode scanners work with no connection. Also fixed: the dropdown arrow no longer overlaps long selected text in any select.
